_comment: Roles that play a lane in this instance's journey processes (processes/content/), each with the skills its lane's tasks need: smart-trust-tools' library skills (hcert-*, vhl-*) and its wallet skills (what the holder and the receiving health worker do), smart-base's point-of-care skills (completing an SDC form, acting on decision support), and this instance's own (skills/journeys/). Schema: cat-harness-tools/schemas/process/role-graph.ts. Every person is fictional.
name: smart-trust-demo

roles.title: Caregiver
roles.description: The parent who holds the child's paper DVCs and the family phone, and presents them; IHE ITI VHL VHL Holder and smart-trust Holder.
roles.persona: A parent carrying a newborn's records across borders on paper and one shared phone; no health training, little time, limited connectivity.

roles.title: Subject of care
roles.description: The person the records are about: the child whose doses are given, signed, registered, verified and shared. Acts through the caregiver, holds no device and plays no lane in the journeys' processes.
roles.persona: A newborn whose vaccination history must follow him across a border he cannot speak for.

roles.title: Birth clinic vaccinator
roles.description: The clinician abroad who gives the birth doses and hands over the signed paper DVC (J1).
roles.persona: A maternity-ward clinician who records doses in the hospital system and prints what it produces.

roles.title: Birth clinic issuing system
roles.description: The hospital system abroad that issues a DVC per dose with the HCERT library: the HCERT issuing system (smart-trust-tools) of a trust network participant (XXR).
roles.persona: Software that calls the library once per dose and never holds the private key; signs only with a DSC its country's CSCA issued and has already shared with the GDHCN.
otherNames: Issuer of the birth-dose DVCs (SMART Trust Issuer)

roles.title: Issuer signing key
roles.description: The DSC private key of the issuing participant, in an HSM, cloud KMS or Android Keystore; signs the bytes the issuing system prepares (two-phase signing, STT-ISS-004).
roles.persona: A key that signs what it is given and reveals nothing else.

roles.title: Community health worker
roles.description: Finds unregistered children on home visits, registers them and refers them to the clinic (J2).
roles.persona: Works on foot and offline, on a cheap Android phone; registers and refers, never judges authenticity.

roles.title: CHW app
roles.description: The OHS app on the CHW's phone: reads a foreign DVC without verifying it (triage read, STT-VER-011), registers the child and records a referral, all offline, syncing later.
roles.persona: Offline-first Android app; must never present an unverified record as verified.

roles.title: Home clinic provider
roles.description: The nurse at the home clinic who receives the referral, has the foreign DVCs verified and decides catch-up doses (J3).
roles.persona: Trusts the system's verdict and needs a reason when a certificate fails.

roles.title: Home clinic EHR
roles.description: The clinic's OHS-based record system: verifies DVCs against the GDHCN trust list, imports them as FHIR Immunization resources and evaluates the national schedule (J3).
roles.persona: Holds the DID trust list from its last refresh, about weekly for a clinic without its own connection, when the CHW visits the base clinic or district health office; loading it is a precondition of a visit, and it verifies offline at the point of care.
otherNames: Verifier at the home clinic (SMART Trust Receiver)

roles.title: GDHCN trust anchor
roles.description: WHO's GDHCN, which receives participants' PKI material and distributes it as DID trust lists; Trust Network Anchor (SMART Trust), Trust Anchor (IHE ITI VHL).
roles.persona: A WHO service publishing DID documents over did:web; verifiers fetch it when online and keep a copy.

roles.title: National health portal
roles.description: The home country's portal that issues each family member's records (IPS, DVCs) as a passcode-protected Verifiable Health Link and hosts the manifests (J4.0), checking the passcode, expiry and consent on each request and logging every access at home (J4.1): the VHL Sharer.
roles.persona: A government service signing with the national DSC, issued under the national CSCA and already shared with the GDHCN; hosts manifests and encrypted documents for a limited time.
otherNames: Issuer of the family's VHLs (SMART Trust Issuer)

roles.title: Family phone
roles.description: The one smartphone the family shares, holding one VHL QR per member (J4); holds links, not keys to anyone's records beyond what each link grants.
roles.persona: A shared Android phone, sometimes offline; whoever holds it can show any member's QR, the passcode protects the records.

roles.title: Point-of-care receiver
roles.description: The clinic system abroad that scans a VHL, verifies it, fetches the manifest (ITI-YY5) and decrypts the documents (J4.1): the VHL Receiver.
roles.persona: A hospital system on a trust network with its own receiver key; its DID trust list is a cache refreshed nightly or hourly, loaded before a visit, so it verifies without being online.
otherNames: Receiver of the family's VHLs (SMART Trust Receiver)

roles.title: Point-of-care provider
roles.description: The clinician abroad who scans the family's QR and reads the child's records (J4.1).
roles.persona: Has minutes, no prior relationship with the family, and her own hospital's system.
